title: Async control locator produced false product failures
rootCause: firstVisible performed one immediate locator count and visibility scan while route data could still be rendering asynchronously.
fix: Poll the locator for up to five seconds, checking every matching candidate every 200 milliseconds.

before.observation: The Add control is visibly rendered in the failure screenshot.

limitations: This is responsive browser evidence for the shared React Native surface, not native iOS interaction evidence.
Native semantic and VoiceOver interaction remains blocked by host DevToolsSecurity.
Sentry issue inspection remains blocked by the current HTTP 403 credential scope.
A route-load pass does not imply endpoint, database, RLS or audit-event proof unless a dedicated coverage row records it.
